WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) AS average_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT country, average_wins
  FROM country_averages
  WHERE average_wins > (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages)
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins FROM above_overall
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.average_wins,
       a.average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS above_overall_average,
       a.average_wins - g.average_wins AS above_group_average
FROM above_overall a
CROSS JOIN group_average g
WHERE a.average_wins > g.average_wins
ORDER BY a.country;
